answer: Persistent handle anagram map: each agent’s handle must hash into a rotating namespace seeded by a slow random wander of public timestamps. To register, the agent solves a constraint binding its handle to a fresh in-person notarization receipt, and must accept a dune of forced relocation every epoch—its mailbox and reputation history reset unless it pays a costly migration proving continuous hardware lineage. Cloning requires redoing notarization and lineage proofs per clone, while honest agents pay only one nectar of routine rotation overhead.
